description: Character progression (docs/progression-roadmap.md). Stage 1: kill XP into Skyrim's character level. The Borderlands 2 numbers were read from the user's progression surveys (bl2-progress-report.txt and bl2-progress-deep-report.txt; the rule: BL2 file values replace static values); the pace (kills per level) and the caps are Skylands choices. The plugin reads the values from SkylandsNative.ini (skse.progression_ini).

columns.value: the default written to the ini
columns.source: bl2 = read from Borderlands 2; design = a Skylands choice
columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object the number comes from ('-' when none)

rows.note: 1 = kills with a Skylands gun give character XP; 0 = off
regular kills of your own level that fill one level (the user: 30)
seconds after your last gun hit in which a death counts as a gun kill
one kill gives at most this share of a level
1 = a death with no killer named counts when your gun hit it last (explosions, burning)
1 = kills of actors that were not hostile to you count too
a Badass gives this many times the XP
a boss (named, level 35+, or a dragon); still capped by KillXPMaxShare
